title: Interests
subtitle: What I do when I step away from the keyboard.

items.title: Pokémon VGC competitor
items.text: Competitive Pokémon player and winner at international tournaments. VGC trains the same muscles I use at work: deep strategic preparation, reading complex systems under pressure, and adapting plans turn by turn.

items.title: Hard rock guitarist
items.text: Soul guitarist trained at a music academy. Hard rock is where I channel the creative side — improvising over a riff is its own kind of problem-solving.

items.title: Ju-Jitsu black belt
items.text: Black belt in Japanese Ju-Jitsu with over 15 years of practice. Discipline, attention to detail, and the value of steady incremental progress — habits that carry directly into how I build software.

items.title: Spartan Race trifecta finisher
items.text: Multi-trifecta Spartan Race finisher. Obstacle racing keeps me battle-tested: pacing long efforts, handling unknown terrain, and refusing to quit when the next obstacle looks impossible.
